title: The 12 Best Air Fryers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 12 picks for air fryers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at air fryers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Ninja AF101 Air Fryer 4 Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-quart ceramic-coated basket, 1550W element, 105°F to 400°F range.
strengths: 105°F floor enables genuine dehydration, jerky and dried fruit, not just reheating
Ceramic-coated crisper plate holds up longer than PTFE in most owner reports
Simple two-knob interface with no touchscreen to fail
limitations: 4-quart basket is honestly sized for 1 to 2 people, not 3 to 4
No food-specific presets, every cook is set manually
Round basket wastes corner space on rectangular foods like chicken breast
features: 4 functions: air fry, roast, reheat, dehydrate

products.name: COSORI Air Fryer Max XL 5.8 Quart CP158-AF
products.blurb: Key specs: 5.8-quart square basket, 1700W element, 11 one-touch presets.
strengths: Square basket holds 15 to 20% more food than a round 5.8-quart at the same rating
11 presets cover fries, chicken, steak, seafood, and bacon without manual setup
1700W gives a 3 to 4-minute preheat to 400°F
limitations: Slightly less crispy than the Ninja AF101 in blind fry comparisons
Square basket corners collect crumbs that need brushing out
11-button interface is more to learn than Ninja's two-knob layout

products.name: Dash Compact Air Fryer 2.6 Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.6-quart basket, 1000W element, Manual dial controls.
strengths: Fits in a cabinet, the smallest footprint in this list
Auto shut-off timer prevents overcooking on short single-serving cycles
limitations: 2.6-quart basket fits one serving of fries or 2 to 4 wings per batch
1000W is noticeably slower to preheat than the Ninja or Cosori
No digital display, timing accuracy depends on the mechanical dial
Non-stick coating shows wear faster than higher-priced baskets under daily use

products.name: Instant Vortex 4-in-1 Air Fryer 6-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart basket, 1500W element, 4-in-1: air fry, roast, reheat, bake.
strengths: EvenCrisp technology reduces the need to shake the basket mid-cycle
4-in-1 functions add roasting and baking beyond basic air frying
limitations: Round basket geometry wastes space versus Cosori's square design at the same rating
Fewer presets than the Cosori Pro line
Some owners report the digital display dims and is hard to read in bright kitchens

products.name: GoWISE USA 5.8-Quart 8-in-1 Digital Air Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5.8-quart basket, 1700W element, 8 digital presets.
strengths: 8 presets cover the common everyday foods without manual dialing
Reliable backup pick when Ninja and Cosori are at full retail
limitations: Temperature accuracy runs less consistent than Ninja or Cosori in side-by-side tests
Basket coating wears faster under daily use than the two market leaders
Fan noise is noticeably louder at high temperatures

products.name: Chefman TurboFry Touch Air Fryer 8 Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-quart basket, 1700W element, Touchscreen controls.
strengths: Touchscreen controls feel more premium than the price suggests
Fits a whole small chicken or 2 pounds of wings in a single batch
limitations: Large footprint takes up meaningfully more counter space than 4 to 6-quart models
Temperature precision is less consistent than Ninja or Cosori at the extremes
Touchscreen is less durable long-term than physical buttons per owner reports

products.name: Philips Essential Airfryer Compact HD9252/91
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.1-quart basket, Rapid Air technology, 1400W element.
strengths: Rapid Air technology from the original air fryer brand produces even results on thick cuts
QuickClean detachable basket sections separate for faster washing
Compact footprint fits smaller kitchens while still using a digital interface
limitations: 4.1-quart capacity is on the smaller side for the same price as 5.8-quart competitors
1400W is the lowest wattage in this list, meaning a longer preheat
Fewer presets than Cosori or GoWISE at the same price point

products.name: Ninja AF161 Max XL Air Fryer 5.5 Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 5.5-quart basket, 1750W Max Crisp technology, 450°F max temperature.
strengths: 450°F max temperature is the highest in this list, for the fastest, crispiest sear
5.5-quart capacity splits the difference between the compact AF101 and full-size models
Ninja's fan and element design carries over the AF101's crisping performance at larger scale
limitations: No dedicated presets, same manual-entry interface as the AF101
Larger unit takes noticeably more counter and storage space than the AF101

products.name: Instant Vortex Plus 6-in-1 6-Quart Air Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart basket, 1500W element, 6-in-1: air fry, roast, broil, bake, reheat, dehydrate.
strengths: 6-in-1 functions add broil and bake beyond the base Vortex 4-in-1
Odor-erase filter is a genuine convenience for strong-smelling foods like fish
6-quart capacity comfortably handles a family-size batch of wings or fries
limitations: More functions mean a steeper learning curve than a simple 4-button model
Round basket wastes usable area versus a same-rated square basket
Bulkier than the base Vortex, taking up more storage space
features: 6-in-1: air fry, roast, broil, bake, reheat, dehydrate

products.name: Gourmia 8 Qt Digital Air Fryer GAF856
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-quart basket, 1700W element, 12 one-touch presets.
strengths: 12 presets is more than most large-basket competitors offer at this price
Fits a whole chicken or 2 pounds of vegetables in one batch
limitations: Temperature accuracy runs noticeably less consistent than the market leaders
Basket coating and handle feel less durable under daily use per owner reports

products.name: COSORI TurboBlaze 6-Quart Air Fryer
strengths: Ceramic-coated basket
90 to 450°F range for dehydrating to searing
6-quart basket serves 3 to 5
Quiet fan with multiple speeds
limitations: Single basket
Coating needs gentle utensils
Large footprint

products.name: Chefman 4 Qt Compact Air Fryer
strengths: Compact footprint
Low price
Simple controls
Quick to preheat
limitations: 4 qt is small for families
Basic features
Nonstick basket needs gentle care

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
